issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
applicability: All MSMEs seeking scheme benefits, priority sector credit or GeM access
data_source: Udyam Registration portal; Ministry of MSME
notes: Free, self-declaration based, PAN and GST linked; replaced Udyog Aadhaar

applicability: Enterprises above the turnover threshold, or making inter-state supply
data_source: GSTN; Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
notes: Threshold differs for goods and services and for special category states

issuing_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
applicability: Any food business operator: manufacture, processing, storage, distribution, sale
notes: Three tiers by turnover and scale: Registration, State Licence, Central Licence

issuing_authority: State Directorate of Factories and Boilers
applicability: Manufacturing units above the worker-count threshold under the Factories Act
notes: Threshold depends on worker count and whether power is used

applicability: Units in the Red, Orange or Green category per CPCB classification
data_source: Central Pollution Control Board; state boards
notes: Consent to Establish then Consent to Operate; White category is exempt

applicability: Most commercial premises within municipal limits
notes: Requirement, fee and process vary widely between local bodies

applicability: Premises above prescribed area, height or occupancy thresholds
notes: Often a precondition for Factory Licence and Trade Licence

applicability: Products under mandatory certification via a Quality Control Order
notes: Mandatory only for notified products; voluntary otherwise

applicability: Voluntary; often a buyer or tender requirement
notes: Not a government licence; ISO 9001 quality, ISO 22000 food, ISO 13485 devices

applicability: Manufacture of drugs, cosmetics or medical devices
notes: Qualified technical staff and premises standards are statutory prerequisites

applicability: Installations above prescribed load or voltage thresholds
notes: Required before energisation of higher-load industrial connections

applicability: Any enterprise importing or exporting goods or services
notes: Mandatory for all cross-border trade; annual electronic update needed to stay active

applicability: Commercial establishments not covered by the Factories Act
notes: Applies to most service and trading businesses

applicability: Producers, importers and recyclers of plastic, e-waste, batteries or tyres
notes: Creates the recycler demand side; registration is on the CPCB EPR portal
